hook: You premoved a recapture. Your opponent found an in-between check. Familiar pain?
text: You premoved a recapture. Your opponent found an in-between check. Familiar pain? The German masters named it a century ago: Zwischenzug (the in-between move). In 3-minute blitz, 80% of lost pieces come from assuming the opponent will play the expected recapture. Before snatching a piece back, always ask: Can they check me first? Train your eye to spot intermediate moves before your opponent spots them for you.

creative.headline:
SPEED SCRAMBLE
*PREMOVE TILT*
creative.subhead: Under 5 seconds, calculation collapses into survival
